guidance: Looking at our standalone financial performance for Q1 FY27, I'm happy to mention that we have met our guidance.

focus: Concurrently, the aerospace and defense sector has experienced structural supply chain shifts, driven by a global surge in aircraft demand and an intense domestic focus on defense self - reliance.

Now on the Q1 FY27 financial performance snapshot, our unwavering focus on operational discipline, operating efficiencies and optimized product segment mixes has enabled us to kick off the new financial year on the stron
We enter the rest of FY27 with absolute clarity and complete execution confidence.
